items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow (no fracture on X-rays); ruled out, additional testing Monday. Last similar injury missed ~4 games/month.
items.why: Carted off after awkward brace fall late first half; Quinn confirmed dislocation, no fracture.
items.implication: Mariota to start Week 3+; Daniels multi-week absence likely; Commanders QB/WR/TE downgrade short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming; elevated targets to WRs/TEs if scheme shifts.

items.text: Ladd McConkey is officially ACTIVE. Smoke em if you got em.
items.why: Official active confirmation after optimism and Rapoport bullish reports; flak jacket expected.
items.implication: Start with injury docks possible; primary target share intact vs Raiders.
items.opportunity: Full routes if no setback; docks for limited practice.

items.text: RJ Harvey is inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason.
items.why: Official inactive after ETR/Levitan not expected and hamstring designation.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup RB role opens fully for Coleman or others in Broncos backfield.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share shift to backups; waiver/stash priority.

items.text: Raiders HC Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers: 'Close, very close. He looks great.' (was out/doubtful recently).
items.implication: Imminent return boosts Raiders TE/offense; stash activate soon.
items.opportunity: High target share upon return; Mayer downgrade reverse.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Williams hamstring, Daniels elbow, Barkley stinger, Price chest, Reed head, Brooks groin, Dowdle toe, Jones knee, Dobbins hamstring, Goedert knee, Douglas ankle, Evans hip (not serious)/Robinson high ankle, Njoku knee etc.
items.why: Compiled in-game/postgame reports; longer list than usual.
items.implication: Monday testing key for many; ROS rankings adjust on severity.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury, questionable to return; Shanahan says doesn't look serious. Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
items.implication: Likely returns soon; short-term 49ers WR depth watch.
items.opportunity: Other WRs if out rest of game/next week.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; walking under own power postgame, tests Monday. Slight limp possible.
items.why: In-game injury; Rap notes walking good spirits better than alternatives.
items.implication: Week 3 status TBD; Bears offense monitors; Loveland etc. usage watch.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, backup QB and skill elevation.

items.text: Packers ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck/head) and RT.
items.implication: GB WR targets to Watson/Wicks/others; watch postgame head.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return.
items.implication: Monitor return; handcuff if sits rest of game; postgame status key for ROS.
items.opportunity: Gainwell or others if extended absence.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) GTD/pre-game decision for MNF vs Giants; trending wrong direction, more likely out than play. Missed Fri/Sat practice.
items.why: Schefter via reports; different from prior issue; no practice late week.
items.implication: High risk for Sunday lock; Adams primary if out; contingency needed for MNF.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target bump; other Rams WRs/TEs elevated.

items.text: Joe Burrow active (was Q back); Chris Olave active. Also McMillan/Hendrickson active; Tua inactive.
items.why: Official actives; Burrow will play confirmed earlier by Rap.
items.implication: Full Bengals stack viable; Olave no docks per Levitan.

items.text: Projecting McConkey in w/ decent injury docks (Rap bullish, status ~2:30pm); Puka true GTD; Olave clean no docks; Harvey->Jonah Coleman look; Pittman->Germie Bernard look.
items.why: Based on Rap tone, practice, reports; projections updated for news.
items.implication: Start McConkey/Olave; fade or handcuff Harvey/Pittman spots; Puka risky for MNF.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Bernard stashes for usage if primary out; McConkey docks reduce ceiling slightly.

items.text: Weekend reports summary: GTD Ladd McConkey (cracked rib, optimism/flak) & Puka Nacua (hip); Not expected RJ Harvey (hamstring); Expected Olave/Burrow/McMillan (snap count)/Black; OUT Flowers (hamstring)/Pittman (foot).
items.why: Compiled beat/insider weekend reports for Sunday slate.
items.implication: Monitor 90-min inactives; beneficiaries for OUTs; docks for GTDs.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups on OUTs (Bateman-type for Flowers; Bernard for Pittman).

items.implication: Ravens WR targets shift; Bateman elevated opportunity noted by Rapoport.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for remaining WRs including Bateman.

items.implication: Colts/PIT WR depth chart opens; Bernard YAC fit with McCarthy per Berry/Levitan.
items.opportunity: Slot/YAC targets to Bernard or others; stash upgrade.

items.text: After 9/155/3 TDs, Jaxon Smith-Njigba is 5th WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yards, TD in each of first two games.
items.implication: Elite WR1 lock; high target/RZ share confirmed.

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return due to chest injury.
items.implication: Monitor; Walker or others if limited ROS.

items.text: Agrees on Germie Bernard stash (YAC man, Pittman out, good McCarthy fit); also Sarratt with Lane out/Flowers issues.
items.why: YAC profile fits offense; opportunity from Pittman OUT.
items.implication: Deep league stash/add for upside targets.
items.opportunity: Potential snap/route increase in slot/YAC role.
